install_tell: yahoo/CMAK — NO built-in authentication; README states to front it with a reverse proxy for auth
misconfig_patterns: deployed with no reverse-proxy auth layer in front

response_markers: HTML title: CMAK or legacy Kafka Manager
active_probe.false_positive_check: run both title variants — CMAK is the 2017+ rename, Kafka Manager the older brand on stale deployments

deployment_tells: collides on port 9000 with Kafdrop — disambiguate by title string
often embeds ZooKeeper connection string (ZK cluster topology)
pivot_paths: partition reassignment, preferred-replica election, topic delete — admin-grade actions unauth
broker config view, ZooKeeper connection string exposure
sources: [Stage -1 correction, 2026-07-14] SOURCE-CHECK 2026-07-14 (github.com/yahoo/CMAK app/views/main.scala.html): title tag is a template variable "@title", NOT a fixed string in source — the rendered value depends on the controller passing the title per-page/per-cluster-name. http.title:"CMAK" is UNVERIFIED from source (may work if a static default title is set at startup, but not confirmed) — treat as a hypothesis to live-test, not confirmed intel. http.title:"Kafka Manager" (legacy rename) has the same caveat.
